title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pineapple Ice serves smooth, juicy Pineapple backed by a brisk, cooling finish. The tropical sweetness comes through first, then a clean icy note rounds off the exhale for a refreshing Pineapple-and-ice profile. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod arrives as a prefilled 2ml pod linked to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no refilling and no coil changes to manage. Just attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The pod’s dual mesh coil and draw-activated inhale help maintain consistent taste and discreet MTL vapour. A single pod can deliver up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on personal use. When flavour drops off or the reservoir runs dry, replace with a fresh Pineapple Ice pod. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
